names.why: Company IR release dated 2026-09-29 says Q2 FY2026 results (16 weeks ending Sept. 12, 2026) come out before the open on Tue Oct 13, call 8:30 a.m. EDT; this is the first print since the July guide cut that took the stock down 21.6%.

Read the pharmacy and Medicare drug-price-negotiation (IRA) disclosure in the Q1 8-K/10-Q. The 8-K blamed part of the sales headwind on it, so look at pharmacy reimbursement trends and at peers' pharmacy commentary (KR, WBA, CVS retail) for the quarter.
Look at grocery trade-down data for the 16 weeks to Sept 12: Kroger's own commentary, Placer.ai/foot-traffic for Safeway/Vons/Jewel, and private-label share data.
Read the CFO transition (Sharon McCollam's retirement) and the restructuring plan announced July 23. Check whether an 8-K has named a successor or added restructuring charges since.
Check buyback pace against the $2bn authorization, and the share count in the Q1 10-Q.
